problem_statement: The ostest nxevent_test now contains new cases that call nxevent_getmask on an nxevent_t object. With the current kernel event subsystem, building or testing ostest fails because the linker reports an undefined reference to nxevent_getmask, so nxevent_test cannot complete. The test exercises the new interface after nxevent_post and nxevent_clear operations and expects it to return the event object's current mask value. In the added cases, after posting 0xff with NXEVENT_POST_SET, nxevent_getmask is expected to return 0xff; after clearing 0xf, it is expected to return 0xf0; and after clearing 0xf0, it is expected to return 0. The issue is observed when building/testing with the test change applied, especially with event support enabled. The required behavior is for the missing interface to be available so that nxevent_test can link and pass, with nxevent_getmask reporting the current mask of the event object as shown by the test cases.
